case_title: NANA KESHAV LAGAD v. STATE OF MAHARASHTRA
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302 rlw s.34 and s.324 rlw s.34
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 read with Section 34 and Section 324 read with Section 34 of IPC
neutral_facts: The accused and the complainant were residents of the same village and owned adjacent agricultural lands. There was a dispute over the right of way to access their respective lands. On 04.10.2002, the accused attacked the complainant and his father with a cycle chain and stone, resulting in the father's death and the complainant's injuries. The complainant provided a detailed account of the incident, including the presence of multiple accused and the use of weapons. The medical evidence confirmed the nature and severity of the injuries, linking them to the use of cycle chain and stone. The trial court convicted the accused based on the eyewitness account, medical evidence, and recovery of weapons. The High Court affirmed the conviction.
